history.title: The Rain Cache
history.narration: Mara carefully walks through the wet city at dusk, her flashlight illuminating the path. The tall tower across from row houses looms in the distance. She reaches a flooded crossing, the rain puddles reflecting the amber light of the street lamp.

history.title: What the Cache Holds
history.narration: Mara carefully walks through the wet city at dusk, her flashlight illuminating the path. The tall tower across from row houses looms in the distance. She reaches a flooded crossing, the rain puddles reflecting the amber light of the street lamp.

history.title: The Neon Sign
history.narration: Mara is cautious as she walks through the dry residential block. She scans the surroundings and notices a neon direction sign. She decides to follow the sign to avoid the rain.

history.title: Trail Behind the Block
history.narration: Mara is running out of time and the darkness is creeping in. She can't trust the dark, but she has to move fast. She scans the surroundings and notices a boulder on the side of the trail. She decides to leave a marker for her return. She takes the radio battery and puts it in her pocket. She continues on the trail, keeping an eye on the boulder.
